change_summary: Replaced the single fused 'for ijk in range(KH * KW * BLOCK_K_COUNT)' loop with three explicit nested tl.static_range loops (kh_idx, kw_idx, k_block) to eliminate runtime modulo/division index arithmetic and reduce register pressure, declared BLOCK_K_COUNT as tl.constexpr, hoisted ih/iw/valid_spatial computation to the kw_idx level, and added maxnreg=128 to all six autotune configs to cap register usage and double theoretical occupancy from 12.5% to 25%.
